purpose: Label-free offline feature preprocessing for the 1,000 SLURP DEV-2000-ADDED devel recordings (owner decision 34 of 2026-09-19; deviations D1/D2/D3 accepted by owner decision 79 of 2026-09-21). A model-free audit (docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-19-slurp-dev-2000-packets/media-inventory.json) measured 0 of 1,000 added rows warm in the legacy feature cache slurp-q4km, so this run contacts every added row exactly once and never re-touches the already-promoted DEV-1000 or DEV-500 packets. Keep the resident decoder-only inference service on port 8080 untouched, populate only the legacy speech feature cache through a separate CPU-only sidecar on port 8081, and never inspect generated text, labels, reference transcripts, or task accuracy. The fixed one-token response is never read semantically. Precedent: SAEA-SN-DEV1000-PREPROCESS (2026-08-24, configs/experiment/slurp-dev1000-preprocess.json).
